```{r read-data}
read_cohort_excel <- function(path, sheet = "Sample info") {
  raw <- readxl::read_excel(path, sheet = sheet, col_names = TRUE,
                            .name_repair = "unique")
  
  # Clean all column names (trim spaces) — do NOT overwrite col 1
  colnames(raw) <- trimws(colnames(raw))
  # Standardise the TRU-ID column name (dash → underscore)
  colnames(raw) <- gsub("^TRU-ID$", "TRU_ID", colnames(raw))

  message("Columns: ", paste(colnames(raw), collapse = " | "))

  # Cohort spreadsheets differ between versions (e.g. v4 had a "Multiome?"
  # column that v6 replaced with "snATAC"). Add any optional columns we
  # reference so they flow through the filter and mutate steps without
  # erroring when absent.
  for (opt in c("snATAC")) {
    if (!opt %in% colnames(raw)) raw[[opt]] <- NA_character_
  }

  df <- raw %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      !is.na(Patient),
      trimws(as.character(Patient)) != "",
      !grepl("EXTRA|SNRNA", as.character(`Cohort ID`), ignore.case = TRUE)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Diagnosis = dplyr::case_when(
        grepl("Oligodendroglioma", Diagnosis, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "IDH-O",
        grepl("Astrocytoma",       Diagnosis, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "IDH-A",
        TRUE ~ as.character(Diagnosis)
      ),
      Grade = as.character(Grade),
      snRNA    = ifelse(grepl("yes", as.character(`Single nuclei?`), ignore.case = TRUE), "Yes", "No"),
      snATAC   = ifelse(grepl("yes", as.character(`snATAC`), ignore.case = TRUE), "Yes", "No"),
      ST       = ifelse(grepl("yes", as.character(`ST?`),            ignore.case = TRUE), "Yes", "No"),
      SM       = ifelse(grepl("yes", as.character(`SM?`),            ignore.case = TRUE), "Yes", "No"),
      Chemo = dplyr::case_when(
        grepl("vorasidenib", as.character(`Chemotherapy prior to surgery`), ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Vorasidenib",
        grepl("safusidenib", as.character(`Chemotherapy prior to surgery`), ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Safusidenib",
        grepl("bev",         as.character(`Chemotherapy prior to surgery`), ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "TMZ+Bev",
        grepl("tmz",         as.character(`Chemotherapy prior to surgery`), ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "TMZ",
        TRUE ~ "No"
      ),
      Radiotherapy = ifelse(
        grepl("yes", as.character(`Radiotherapy prior to surgery`), ignore.case = TRUE),
        "Yes", "No"
      ),
      Surgery = dplyr::case_when(
        grepl("Sub_Treated",   Resection, ignore.case = TRUE)                                            ~ "Subsequent_Treated",
        grepl("Sub_Untreated", Resection, ignore.case = TRUE)                                            ~ "Subsequent_Untreated",
        grepl("Subsequent",    Resection, ignore.case = TRUE) & (Chemo != "No" | Radiotherapy == "Yes") ~ "Subsequent_Treated",
        grepl("Subsequent",    Resection, ignore.case = TRUE)                                            ~ "Subsequent_Untreated",
        grepl("Initial",       Resection, ignore.case = TRUE) & (Chemo != "No" | Radiotherapy == "Yes") ~ "Initial_Treated",
        grepl("Initial",       Resection, ignore.case = TRUE)                                            ~ "Initial",
        TRUE ~ as.character(Resection)
      ),
      Cohort = dplyr::case_when(
        grepl("ven",          as.character(`Cohort ID`), ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "VENTURE",
        grepl("anheart",      as.character(`Cohort ID`), ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "AnHeart",
        grepl("longitudinal", as.character(`Cohort ID`), ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Longitudinal",
        grepl("progression",  as.character(`Cohort ID`), ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Paired Progression",
        grepl("naïve|naive",  as.character(`Cohort ID`), ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Naïve",
        TRUE ~ as.character(`Cohort ID`)
      ),
      ST_sections = suppressWarnings(as.integer(`ST_section Number`)),
      SM_sections = suppressWarnings(as.integer(`SM_Section Number`)),
      serial      = grepl("^yes$", trimws(tolower(as.character(`ST_SM_Serial Sections`))))
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      ST_sections = ifelse(is.na(ST_sections), 0L, ST_sections),
      SM_sections = ifelse(is.na(SM_sections), 0L, SM_sections),
      Patient       = trimws(as.character(Patient)),
      Patient_clean = sub("(-[0-9]+)(-[0-9]+)$", "\\1", 
                          regmatches(Patient, regexpr("^[A-Za-z]+-[0-9]+(?:-[0-9]+)?", Patient, perl = TRUE))),
      PatientBase   = ifelse(
                          grepl("^[A-Za-z]+-[0-9]+-[0-9]+$", Patient_clean),
                          sub("-[0-9]+$", "", Patient_clean),   # "A-5-1" → "A-5"
                          Patient_clean                          # "A-1"   → "A-1"
                        )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      Patient, Patient_clean, PatientBase,
      GL_ID,
      Cohort, Diagnosis, Grade,
      Surgery, Sex, Age = `Age at surgery`,
      Chemo, Radiotherapy, snRNA, snATAC,
      
      ST, ST_sections,
      SM, SM_sections,
      serial
    ) %>%
    dplyr::distinct()

  return(df)
}

# ---- Methylation (De Souza G-CIMP) classification --------------------------
# Joined onto the cohort by GL_ID. In Cohorts_v6 the GL_ID column carries
# timepoint suffixes (e.g. GL0110-2, GL0048-1) that match gl_id here exactly.
read_methylation <- function(path, sheet = "gcimp_classification_results") {
  meth <- readxl::read_excel(path, sheet = sheet, .name_repair = "unique")
  colnames(meth) <- trimws(colnames(meth))

  meth %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      GL_ID       = trimws(as.character(gl_id)),
      Methylation = dplyr::case_when(
        grepl("high", as.character(desouza_signature_class), ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "G-CIMP-high",
        grepl("low",  as.character(desouza_signature_class), ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "G-CIMP-low",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
      )
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(GL_ID), GL_ID != "") %>%
    dplyr::distinct(GL_ID, .keep_all = TRUE)
}

data_dir <- "/stornext/Bioinf/data/lab_brain_cancer/projects/tme_spatial/venture_multi_omics"

df <- read_cohort_excel(file.path(data_dir, "Venture_Paper_Cohorts_7.xlsx"))

meth <- read_methylation(file.path(data_dir, "venture_desouza_gcimp_classification.xlsx"))

# Left-join so cohort samples without methylation data keep an NA (rendered
# grey via na.value in the tile rows).
df <- df %>%
  dplyr::mutate(GL_ID = trimws(as.character(GL_ID))) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(meth, by = "GL_ID")

message("Methylation matched: ",
        sum(!is.na(df$Methylation)), " / ", nrow(df), " samples")
```

```{r palettes}
patient_levels <- df %>%
  dplyr::distinct(PatientBase) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(PatientBase) %>%
  dplyr::pull(PatientBase)

base_cols <- c(
  RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(8, "Set1"),
  RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(8, "Dark2"),
  RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(8, "Set2"),
  RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(8, "Accent")
)
base_cols <- base_cols[!base_cols %in% c("#FFFFFF", "#F0F0F0", "#BEBEBE")]

n   <- length(patient_levels)
idx <- order(seq(1, n) %% ceiling(n / 4) * 4 + seq(1, n) %/% ceiling(n / 4))
patient_cols <- setNames(base_cols[seq_len(n)][idx], patient_levels)

diag_cols    <- c("IDH-A" = "#76B7B2", "IDH-O" = "#EDC948")

grade_cols   <- c("2" = "#E8DAEF", "3" = "#8E44AD", "4" = "#4A235A")

# Magenta/pink — a hue used by no other track (Grade is purple), so the
# methylation row reads distinctly. Dark = high, light = low.
meth_cols    <- c("G-CIMP-high" = "#AD1457", "G-CIMP-low" = "#F48FB1")

surgery_cols <- c(
  "Initial"    = "#A9DFBF",
  "Initial_Treated"      = "#27AE60",
  "Subsequent_Untreated" = "#1E8449",
  "Subsequent_Treated"   = "#0B5345"
)

chemo_cols <- c(
  "No"          = "#FDF5E6",
  "TMZ"         = "#FAD7A0",
  "TMZ+Bev"     = "#E59866",
  "Vorasidenib" = "#CA6F1E",
  "Safusidenib" = "#784212"
)

radio_cols <- c("No" = "#FDEDEC", "Yes" = "#E74C3C")

yn_cols    <- c("No" = "#EBF5FB", "Yes" = "#2471A3")
```

```{r helpers}
make_row <- function(data, var, fill_map, label) {
  n_tiles <- nrow(data)
  vals    <- unique(data[[var]]); vals <- vals[!is.na(vals)]
  missing <- setdiff(vals, names(fill_map))
  if (length(missing) > 0)
    fill_map <- c(fill_map, setNames(rep("grey80", length(missing)), missing))

  ggplot(data, aes(x = x, y = 1, fill = .data[[var]])) +
    geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = fill_map, name = label,
                      na.value = "grey90", drop = FALSE) +
    scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(aspect.ratio    = 1 / n_tiles,
          legend.position = "right",
          legend.title    = element_text(size = 7, face = "bold"),
          legend.text     = element_text(size = 6),
          legend.key.width  = unit(0.35, "cm"),
          legend.key.height = unit(0.35, "cm"),
          plot.margin     = margin(2, 2, 2, 80))
}

make_row_sectioned <- function(data, var, fill_map, label, section_var) {
  n_tiles <- nrow(data)
  vals    <- unique(data[[var]]); vals <- vals[!is.na(vals)]
  missing <- setdiff(vals, names(fill_map))
  if (length(missing) > 0)
    fill_map <- c(fill_map, setNames(rep("grey80", length(missing)), missing))

  ggplot(data, aes(x = x, y = 1, fill = .data[[var]])) +
    geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = fill_map, name = label,
                      na.value = "grey90", drop = FALSE) +
    scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(aspect.ratio    = 1 / n_tiles,
          legend.position = "right",
          legend.title    = element_text(size = 7, face = "bold"),
          legend.text     = element_text(size = 6),
          legend.key.width  = unit(0.35, "cm"),
          legend.key.height = unit(0.35, "cm"),
          plot.margin     = margin(2, 2, 2, 80))
}

add_ylabel <- function(p, label) {
  p + labs(y = label) +
    theme(
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold", angle = 0,
                                  hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5, color = "grey20"),
      axis.title.x = element_blank()
    )
}
```

```{r build-plot}
# Sort by modality completeness, then cohort narrative order, then PatientBase.
# Tier 1: full multi-omics (ST+SM+snRNA) — VENTURE then AnHeart
# Tier 2: ST+snRNA (no SM)
# Tier 3: ST+SM (no snRNA)
# Tier 4: ST only — Longitudinal timepoints, Paired Progression, Naïve pairs
# Tier 5: snRNA only
# Tier 6: no modalities (clinical-only)
# PatientBase alpha within each cell keeps longitudinal/paired samples adjacent.
df <- df %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    .modality_tier = dplyr::case_when(
      ST == "Yes" & SM == "Yes" & snRNA == "Yes" ~ 1L,
      ST == "Yes" & snRNA == "Yes"               ~ 2L,
      ST == "Yes" & SM == "Yes"                  ~ 3L,
      ST == "Yes"                                ~ 4L,
      snRNA == "Yes"                             ~ 5L,
      TRUE                                       ~ 6L
    ),
    .cohort_order = dplyr::case_when(
      Cohort == "VENTURE"                                  ~ 1L,
      Cohort == "AnHeart"                                  ~ 2L,
      Cohort == "Longitudinal"                             ~ 3L,
      Cohort == "Paired Progression"                       ~ 4L,
      grepl("naïve|naive", Cohort, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ 5L,
      TRUE                                                 ~ 6L
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(.modality_tier, .cohort_order, PatientBase) %>%
  dplyr::select(-.modality_tier, -.cohort_order) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(x = seq_len(dplyr::n()))

# Row specs — section_var drives subdivision for ST and SM
rows_spec <- list(
  list(var = "PatientBase",  map = patient_cols,  label = "Patient",              section_var = NULL),
  list(var = "Diagnosis",    map = diag_cols,      label = "Diagnosis",            section_var = NULL),
  list(var = "Grade",        map = grade_cols,     label = "Grade",                section_var = NULL),
  list(var = "Methylation",  map = meth_cols,      label = "Methylation (G-CIMP)", section_var = NULL),
  list(var = "Surgery",      map = surgery_cols,   label = "Surgery",              section_var = NULL),
  list(var = "Chemo",        map = chemo_cols,     label = "Treatment",            section_var = NULL),
  list(var = "Radiotherapy", map = radio_cols,     label = "Radiotherapy",         section_var = NULL),
  list(var = "ST",           map = yn_cols,        label = "Xenium ST",            section_var = "ST_sections"),
  list(var = "SM",           map = yn_cols,        label = "Spatial Metabolomics", section_var = "SM_sections"),
  list(var = "snRNA",        map = yn_cols,        label = "snRNA-seq",            section_var = NULL),
  list(var = "snATAC",       map = yn_cols,        label = "snATAC",               section_var = NULL)
)

rows <- lapply(rows_spec, function(s) {
  p <- if (!is.null(s$section_var)) {
    make_row_sectioned(df, s$var, s$map, s$label, s$section_var)
  } else {
    make_row(df, s$var, s$map, s$label)
  }
  add_ylabel(p, s$label)
})

# Patient label row — x is pre-assigned in df
p_labels <- ggplot(df, aes(x = x, y = 1, label = Patient)) +
  geom_text(size = 2.2, angle = 45, hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5, color = "grey20") +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), limits = c(0.5, nrow(df) + 0.5)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0.8, 2)) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(plot.margin = margin(0, 2, 0, 80))

# Strip legends from individual rows
rows_no_legend <- lapply(rows, function(p) p + theme(legend.position = "none"))

# aspect.ratio = 1/N in each tile row forces square panels.
# Figure dimensions are computed from tile_size so ggsave matches.
# 82pt left margin + 2pt right = 1.14"; legend takes 3/13 of total width.
tile_size      <- 0.4   # inches per tile — adjust to scale the whole figure
n_patients     <- nrow(df)
n_tile_rows    <- length(rows_spec)
label_tiles    <- 3     # height of patient-label row in tile units
heights_vec    <- c(label_tiles, rep(1, n_tile_rows))
fig_width      <- (n_patients * tile_size + 1.14) * (13 / 10)
fig_height     <- tile_size * sum(heights_vec) + 1.1   # +1.1 for title/caption/margins

main_plot <- wrap_plots(c(list(p_labels), rows_no_legend), ncol = 1,
                        heights = heights_vec) +
  plot_annotation(
    title   = "VENTURE Cohort — Sample Overview",
    caption = "IDH-A: IDH-mutant Astrocytoma  |  IDH-O: IDH-mutant Oligodendroglioma",
    theme   = theme(
      plot.title   = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      plot.caption = element_text(size = 7, color = "grey50", hjust = 0.5)
    )
  )

# Build legend panel (exclude Patient — too many levels)
legend_df <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(rows_spec, function(s) {
  if (s$label == "Patient") return(NULL)
  lvls <- names(s$map)
  data.frame(
    group = factor(s$label, levels = sapply(rows_spec, `[[`, "label")),
    level = factor(lvls, levels = lvls),
    color = unname(s$map[lvls]),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}))

legend_df$fill_id <- paste(legend_df$group, legend_df$level, sep = "::")
all_colors        <- setNames(legend_df$color, legend_df$fill_id)

legend_panel <- ggplot(legend_df, aes(x = 0.15, y = level)) +
  # shape 22 = filled square with absolute size, so keys stay square regardless
  # of how the facet panels stretch (geom_tile keys took the panel aspect ratio)
  geom_point(aes(fill = fill_id), shape = 22, size = 4,
             color = "white", stroke = 0.3) +
  geom_text(aes(x = 0.32, label = as.character(level)),
            hjust = 0, size = 2.8, color = "grey15") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = all_colors, guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1.5), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  facet_wrap(~ group, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y", strip.position = "left") +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    strip.text.y.left = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold", angle = 0,
                                     hjust = 1, color = "grey10",
                                     margin = margin(r = 4)),
    strip.placement = "outside",
    panel.spacing   = unit(0.25, "cm"),
    plot.margin     = margin(4, 4, 4, 4)
  )

# Final assembly
final_plot <- (main_plot | legend_panel) +
  plot_layout(widths = c(10, 3))

# Save
ggsave("/vast/projects/BCRL_Multi_Omics/venture_cohort_fig1_092026.pdf", final_plot,
       width = fig_width, height = fig_height, units = "in", device = cairo_pdf)
ggsave("/vast/projects/BCRL_Multi_Omics/venture_cohort_fig1_092026.png", final_plot,
       width = fig_width, height = fig_height, units = "in", dpi = 300)

print(final_plot)
```
